description: Where Luuka's clockings are read from. BioTime holds what every machine pushed to it, so this app asks BioTime once rather than dialling each machine.

fields.label: Read from BioTime
fields.description: While this is off nothing is pulled, and any machine still set to Direct is polled as before.

fields.label: Address
fields.description: For example https://biotime.luuka.co.ug:8098 — the address the Frappe server itself can reach, not the one on somebody's desk.

fields.label: BioTime User
fields.description: A BioTime account with permission to read transactions. Give it that and nothing else.

fields.label: Verify the Certificate
fields.description: Leave ticked on https. A BioTime with a self-signed certificate needs this off, and then the connection is private but not proven.

fields.label: What is read
fields.description: BioTime answers in its own server's local time and so does this app. If the two disagree the punches land in the wrong hour — check the clocks, not the code.

fields.label: First Pull Reaches Back (Days)
fields.description: Only used the very first time, when there is no last sync to read from.

fields.label: Sign-in Path
fields.description: BioTime 8.5's own. A different version is a setting, not a code change.

fields.label: Last Read Up To
fields.description: The next pull starts a minute before this, so a punch recorded just after a run is not lost between two of them.

name: BioTime Server
